camera.evidence: background regions differ by <0.13 grey levels between frames; no pan/shake
camera.view: side view, motion left->right parallel to image x axis; grey studio backdrop with a bright lit floor band (brightest row ~638-640, wall/floor transition ~y 580-600)
camera.perspective: animals rest on slightly different ground rows (red horse hooves y~629-631, dun horse y~634, rabbit y~636-639), so red horse is a little farther and rabbit a little nearer than the dun horse; treated as one plane in a 2D scene

horse_red.desc: smaller chestnut/red-brown horse with dark mane & tail, white socks on hind legs, untextured grey face; leftmost animal
horse_red.motion: walks rightwards frames 0-48 (~+150 px); at frame 49 it jumps back to ~its frame-0 position (animation loop reset / teleport)

horse_dun.desc: larger light-brown (dun/buckskin) horse with black legs, mane and tail, untextured grey face; middle animal
horse_dun.motion: walks rightwards the whole clip (~+290 px)

rabbit.desc: small orange-brown rabbit just ahead of (right of) the dun horse front hooves, on the ground
rabbit.motion: hops/runs rightwards the whole clip (~+300 px), periodic crouch-stretch gait ~10 frames

floor_backdrop.desc: seamless grey studio floor and wall; bright band around y 600-680

events.event: all three animals already moving rightwards at clip start
last frame of red horse continuous walk
red horse jumps back ~153 px (torso x 801 -> 647), discontinuity; other animals continue
rabbit crouch phases (local minima of mask height)

track_columns: frame,time,cx_bbox,cy_bbox (bbox centre),cx_centroid,cy_centroid (mask centroid),cx_torso,cy_torso (centroid of mask rows 25-60% of height),x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max (mask bbox, inclusive px),length_px (x extent),height_px (y extent),area_px,occluded
